title: SorceryCraft
description: This is a Jujutsu Kaisen Mod that adds several different curse techniques that integrate into Minecraft's progression
body:
THIS MOD REQUIRES Pekui

This mod adds 4 Curse Techniques To Choose From, Each offering different powers and abilities. These abilities rely on Negative energy created from Negative Emotions.
Current Techniques Added:
Limitless
Shrine
Projection Sorcery
Cursed Energy Discharge


You can level up your skills and techniques by defeating cursed spirits categorized in grades.
Grade 4, A wooden sword is enough.
Grade 3, If you have a Iron Axe, you can rest easy.
Grade 2, Close call with an Diamond Sword.
Grade 1, Even a Netherite Axe might be insufficient.
Special Grade, TNT Minecarts might work.
